Present : Mr. Randeep Singh Rai, Sr. Advocate with
 Ms. Eknoor Kaur Sara, Advocat4e
 for the petitioner.
Mr. Ramdeep Partap Singh, Sr. Dag, Punjab.

Mr. P.S. Ahluwalia, Advocate
 for the complainant.

The present petition has been filed under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in case FIR No.43 dated 28.07.2017 under Sections 420 and 506 of the IPC, registered at Police Station Rajpura, District Patiala.
Learned senior counsel for the petitioner submits that in compliance of order dated 06.12.2017, the petitioner has joined investigation and cooperated with the investigating agency.

Learned State counsel assisted by learned counsel for the complainant on instructions, does not dispute the factum of the petitioner having joined investigation and cooperated with the investigating agency.

Learned State counsel on further instructions submits that the petitioner is not required for further investigation much less for her custodial interrogation moreso as the challan Anchal Narang vs State Of Punjab on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177289066/
1 now stands presented before the Court concerned.
1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:032005 CRM-M-45156-2017 (O&M) -2-

sentences.text:
In view of the above, the petition is allowed and interim order dated 06.12.2017, is made absolute subject to the conditions laid down in Section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
21.02.2023 (MANJARI NEHRU KAUL)
Vinay JUDGE
